checks: Independent re-derivation (team/checks/q7_check.py): Xb4d native 0.95" cubes, different baseline (median of 600-1500 km/s channels, no linear fit), +-350 km/s moment-0, annuli about N(0,+2.63) and S(-0.15,-2.64). HCN/HCO+ N, r<0.5/0.5-1/1-1.5/1.5-2/2-3" = 0.84/0.71/0.56/0.46/0.40; S = 0.40/0.37/0.36/0.38/0.39. Agrees with worker's Xb4d column (0.805/0.726/0.599/0.474/0.399; differences only from beam-matching vs native and baseline). N rises 2-2.1x inward, S flat: confirmed, and it is independent of array (Xb4b-at-1.05" vs Xb4d agree 2-4% inside 1").

Xb4b 0.30" profile (0.98/0.95/0.87/0.64/0.45/0.42/0.30) is internally consistent across windows pm165/pm350/core100 in q7_profiles.log (inner values identical within 0.02); injection of flat ratio returns flat (offsets <=0.03 inside 1"), so pipeline does not manufacture the gradient. Agree.

Peak-pixel ratio ~1 is supported by native-beam peak spectra (T_peak 2.69 K vs 2.87 K, same convention as team-b). Agree. S peak T ratio 0.52 vs integrated 0.42 is flagged and explained (narrower HCN): fine.

Gaussian-excess fit: best FWHM ~0.6" (~115 pc), point-source 1.56x rss. This correctly refines p0005/p0007 ('compact <0.25"'); but no formal errors and k degenerate with A, so quote it only as 'resolved, ~0.3-1" (60-200 pc), not point-like'.

Disk 2-1 ratio 0.58/0.555/0.49 (Xb55, 10" beam): reproduced numbers and zero-level sensitivity (+-0.004). BUT annuli of 4" width are smaller than the 9x6" beam, so the three values are not independent and the radial trend is partly a convolution of the nuclear N/S sources; and 7-m only loses extended flux differently for the two lines. The 12% drop is real as a number but its interpretation as a 'disk' vs 'nuclear' gradient is only qualitative. Partly agree.

Conflict check with forum: consistent with p0005, p0007 and with p0008 (array recovery <~10% systematic on ratios) - the Xb4b-vs-Xb4d offset grows to 18% at 2-3", i.e. larger than p0008's 10% budget in the outskirts; worker states this and uses Xb4d for r>1.5". Agree.

fixes.what: Wording before publication: state the headline as 'HCN/HCO+ 3-2 flux ratio rises ~2.5x (0.3-0.4 at 2-3" to ~1.0 at the peak pixel) over a ~0.5-1" (100-200 pc) gradient in N; S flat ~0.33-0.43; excess is resolved (FWHM ~0.6"), not <0.25"'. Say explicitly it is a flux/brightness-temperature ratio, so opacity/excitation vs abundance remains open (Q4/Q9).
fixes.why: Overstating 'compact core' and an 'abundance' reading is not supported; both lines are thick (Q4).
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Quote beam-matched annulus ratios with null-window errors and the array-recovery budget (>10% beyond 1.5" for Xb4b), and distinguish peak-pixel from aperture values.

fixes.what: Qualify the disk 2-1 statement: annuli narrower than the beam are correlated, 7-m only, no flux-recovery correction. Report it as 'integrated 2-1 ratio falls ~12% from the inner 8" to 8-12", consistent with N-dominated nuclear weighting', not as an independent disk radial profile; do not compare it quantitatively to the 3-2 gradient.
fixes.why: Different J and a beam larger than the bins.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Convolve the Xb4d/Xb4f 3-2 maps to the Xb55 beam and compute the same annuli to compare like with like (cheap, optional).
